title: Recover phase with Griffin-Lim, and stretch time
brief: Measure spectral convergence, build Griffin-Lim and its fast momentum version, and time-stretch a signal with a phase vocoder that keeps its pitch.
hints: np.exp(1j * np.angle(c)) keeps only the phase of c, and is 1 where c is 0, so no division by zero is needed.
Keep the previous projection t outside the loop, starting as None, and update it after you compute the momentum step.
griffin_lim with n_iter=0 skips the loop and inverts the random-phase start directly; the checks use this to test your start.
In phase_vocoder, wrap a phase difference d to [-pi, pi] with d - 2 * np.pi * np.round(d / (2 * np.pi)).
The running phase in phase_vocoder advances by expected + deviation after each output frame, not before the first one.
